items.title: Associated primes of a tensor product with a complete module do not meet the extended ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an adically complete module the associated primes of a tensor product with an arbitrary module never generate the unit ideal together with the extended ideal (statement lines 4348-4355, tag 05JC-adjacent). The proof views everything over the completion, picks an element whose annihilator is the given associated prime, uses that the element is nonzero to find a maximal ideal of the completion containing the extended prime, and concludes because the extended ideal lies in every such maximal ideal. The reduction to the completion is the substance, so the claim is H2.
